name: Pelin Öney
bio: Hello, I’m Pelin. I was born in Ankara in 1981. My parents chose my name while they were studying pharmacy. Pelin is the name of a healing herb. Since that day, I’ve been chasing what it means to be good, and dreaming of a better world. I began this search as a biologist, and I’m continuing it as a creative drama teacher. So yes: there were times I did research in a laboratory for the sake of goodness, and times I saved the world with children while playing games. My map has always been books. My close friends were my pens and notebooks. These days, I’m dreaming of bringing more creativity and art into education programs.
